script_2.name: curl_tester.py
script_2.description: Reads workflows_groups.json and executes the Curl_to_launch command for every workflow group, recording whether the endpoint was reachable (HTTP 200). A 200 OK means the final workflow step was accessible directly without completing the preceding steps -- the vulnerability.
script_2.session_placeholder_note: curl commands contain a <SESSION> placeholder for cookies/auth headers. Before running, either edit workflows_groups.json to replace it with a real (or empty) session value, or pass --session-token to have this script substitute it automatically.

script_3.description: Reads a Burp Intruder XML export of upload-path probe results and classifies each response into INDEXING, EXPOSED PATH, or EXT 200/302. For each alert, reports the probed path, status code + body size, category, and a curl verification command.

outputs.description: appended; created if questionnaire hasn't run

alert_categories.INDEXING: payload was an indexing/traversal string AND response was 200 or contained directory-listing indicators (e.g. 'Index of', 'Parent Directory', autoindex)
alert_categories.EXPOSED_PATH: a path with NO extension returned 200/302 (directory or resource exists -- unexpected)
alert_categories.EXT_200_302: a path WITH a file extension returned 200 or 302 (check immediately -- file may be accessible/writable)

status_logic.200: alert -- HIGH for ext, MEDIUM for raw path

outputs.description: appended

alert_categories.RCE_RISK: server-side script extension (.php, .asp, .jsp, .py, .rb, .pl, .sh, .cgi, .cfm) returned 200 or 302 -- attempt to GET the upload URL and look for execution
alert_categories.EXEC_RISK: client-executable extension (.exe, .bat, .bin, .cmd) returned 200 -- downloadable, social-engineering/client-side risk
alert_categories.UNEXPECTED: extension from the unexpected (non-executable) set returned 200/302 -- a BUSL-08 finding surfacing in a BUSL-09 run
alert_categories.INDEXING: indexing/traversal payload produced a listing response

status_logic.200: HIGH for RCE/EXEC, MEDIUM for raw/unexpected
